track_name: WeatherTech Raceway at Laguna Seca - Full Course
title: iRacing Track Guide Laguna Seca | Formula Vee | 1:43.061

corners.label: T2
corners.braking: brake on two board, straight line to apex

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: dab of brakes between the one and two board, 150 mark
corners.line: turn in at the two board, use all of the curb
corners.exit: smooth exit, get on full power as soon as possible
corners.mistakes: running wide, missing the apex, hitting the red kerb

corners.label: T4
corners.line: use all of the curb, follow as the curb tapers back onto the track
corners.exit: smooth exit, get on throttle nice and early
corners.mistakes: missing the red kerb, using all of the exit curve

corners.label: T5
corners.exit: get on throttle nice and early

corners.label: T8
corners.braking: brake in a straight line along the curbing
corners.mistakes: awkward because there is an off track and a slow down on the second part

corners.line: miss the red thing on the inside

corners.braking: break i don't change down the gear
corners.mistakes: be very cautious turning in with brakes here the rear end of the car will let go quite easily

corners.braking: stand on the brakes just down one gear
corners.line: hit the red kerb because we're going a lot slower
corners.exit: full power there and did get a little bit of a slide going on keep it in a straight line to the apex just under the bridge there

general_tips: Check track temperature and adjust braking points accordingly.
Be cautious of rear-end instability under braking.
Ease off the brakes, gently turn in, then get on power.
Third gear is deceptive; change gear earlier than expected.
high brake bias in 60s, dropped to 58-60%
this car is all about apex speed
get on full power as soon as possible
don't use all of the exit curve
the car cam doesn't go through the dip so it really does rotate quite well up the hill
